Distinct tendrils of cloud form whenever we beam communications to our allies' research teams - but only then. A vivid, cyan tint within the gas gives it the appearance of a planetary aurora - only its various bands will spontaneously switch from sweeping curves to right-angles, as though forming a digital wave.

On our own, we are unable to discern any further meaning from these behaviors - but the [root.GetAllianceName] expects to have more answers once every member's results are collated.

Early theories suggest these dimension-spanning entities somehow harmonize with our hyperspace communication bands. This accidental lure could be kept in place in order to further exploit the entity for study, or we could switch frequencies in the hopes of dispersing it.

texts.zh:
在对我们的研究结果进行比对后发现，这些在我们联邦成员国首都盘绕的、看似没有知觉的极光状云团事实上组成了一个单一的有生命实体。

研究者们能得出的结果如下：这个居住在超空间的实体因为事故漂移到了我们联邦的宇域，它被“钩在”我们最为繁忙（也就是为我们首都的恒星基地提供服务）的太空通讯中继器上。研究者一致同意这个气态实体之前正尝试重组自身，如果不是现在的状况，它处于碎片状态下是做不到这件事的。

在重组完成后，这朵云消失了，它回到了超空间中——但在此之前它到访了我们联盟中的许多研究站。在每个研究站，它多次准确地穿入穿出超空间，在旁观者看来如同舞蹈一般。云朵展示了它穿越超空间屏障的本能，这为我们提供了无价的数据。
texts.en:
The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

As best the researchers can tell: this hyperspace-dwelling entity drifted into our federation space by accident, whereupon it became 'snagged' on our busiest, spaceborne communications relays - those which serve our capital starbases. Researchers agree that the gaseous entity was attempting to reconstitute itself - a task it could otherwise not achieve in such a fragmented state.

After it reformed, the cloud disappeared back into hyperspace - but not before visiting a number of our alliance's research stations. At each one, it performed a number of precise movements in and out of hyperspace - a display which some witnesses describe as resembling a dance. These demonstrations of the cloud's innate ability to traverse the hyperspace barrier have provided us all with invaluable data.

texts.zh:
由于我们没有对这一项目进行合作研究，关于这个造访我们首都的跨维度云团，我们很难确切得到些什么。理论众说纷纭，但我们都观察到这些云团变得相当躁动。

它们的物理结构开始解体，我们注意到这些云团对于刺激的反应也减少了。它们开始更为迅速地穿入穿出超空间。这在我们的通讯频段上产生了显著的静态干扰，但也为[root.Capital.GetName]的理论研究者提供了宝贵的数据。
texts.en:
With no collaborative effort having been applied this project, little can be said with any certainty about the pan-dimensional cloud visiting our capitals. Theories abound, but all of us are now witness to these clouds' stormy agitation.

As their physical structure breaks down, we note that the clouds become less responsive to stimuli. They have begun phasing in and out of hyperspace much more rapidly. This is generating a significant amount of static on many of our communications bands, but it is also providing valuable data for our theoretical researchers in [root.Capital.GetName].

tooltips.zh: [Root.GetAllianceName]收到临时的团结度增益。
tooltips.en: [Root.GetAllianceName] receives a temporary boost to cohesion.

texts.zh:
在对我们的研究结果进行比对后发现，这些在我们联邦成员国首都盘绕的、看似没有知觉的极光状云团事实上组成了一个单一的有生命实体。

我们收集到的数据并不完整，但足以推断出我们遭遇了一个格式塔存在：这个气态存在适于居住在超空间中。项目合作者提出理论，认为这朵云的各个部分在漂移过我们星系时被“钩在”了首都的恒星基地上。它似乎想要重组自身——但由于我方没有一致为其提供帮助，这朵云的某些部分渐渐散去，不再能参与到重组中了。

那些成功重组的部分随后消失去了超空间之中；余下的部分可以继续为研究者提供关于超空间的、有趣的遥测数据。
texts.en:
The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

The data we have is incomplete, but is enough to suggest we have encountered a gestalt being: gaseous in form, and adapted to dwelling in hyperspace. Project coordinators theorize that various parts of the cloud became 'snagged' on our capital starbases whilst it drifted through our galaxy. It appears to have wanted to reconstitute itself - but without a united effort on our part, some of those clouds have begun to lose cohesion, and may no longer be able to rejoin.

Those parts of the cloud which did reunite soon vanished into hyperspace; what remains continues to provide researchers with interesting telemetry on matters relating to hyperspace.

label.zh: 这样的话，或许能从中得到某些益处。
label.en: Some benefit may yet be gleaned, then.

texts.zh:
[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使[event_envoy.GetName]在[Root.Capital.GetName]上代表[envoy_source.GetAdj]利益的方式恼人又令人厌倦。自[event_envoy.GetHerHis]初来这里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就始终对[Root.GetGovernmentName]满怀敌意，对我国的政策和行动几乎持续不断地加以反对。[event_envoy.GetSheHe]实在太过烦人，如果能摆脱掉[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，没几个人会不开心的，而且我们已经收到传言，说一个[Root.GetAdj]忠诚者团体正阴谋加速[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的离世。

允许这项阴谋继续下去当然十分容易，但让外国要人在我国境内被刺杀或许算不得什么好事。
texts.en:
The [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has been exasperatingly tiresome in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] efforts to represent [envoy_source.GetAdj] interests in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Right from [event_envoy.GetHerHis] first arrival, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] shown unremitting hostility towards the [Root.GetGovernmentName], unleashing an almost constant barrage of objections to our policies and actions. So great an irritation [event_envoy.GetHasHave] [event_envoy.GetSheHe] been that few would weep to see the back of [event_envoy.GetHerHim], and we have heard whispers that a group of [Root.GetAdj] loyalists are plotting to expedite [event_envoy.GetHerHis] demise.

Allowing this scheme to succeed would certainly be convenient, but allowing foreign dignitaries to be assassinated in our realm might not be the best of looks.

label.zh: 我们不能对此坐视不理。揪出这个阴谋！
label.en: We will not stoop to such measures. Snuff out the plot!

label.zh: 就让这个烦人的特使消失好了。
label.en: Let us be rid of this troublesome envoy.

texts.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]——我国派去调解与[From.GetName]间争议的特使被谋杀了！[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]在几天前消失的无影无踪，错过了[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原计划与[Root.GetRulerTitle]议会进行的沟通。在搜索数日后，[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的遗体在一个即将被焚化的收纳箱中被发现。

[From.GetAdj]政府推三阻四，不愿发起调查，让人怀疑他们是谋杀的幕后主使——尤其因为[event_envoy.GetName]近来对[From.GetGovernmentName]大加抨击。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName] - the envoy we sent to mediate our disagreements with the [From.GetName] - has been murdered! [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] disappeared without a trace several days ago, missing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] scheduled sync with the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s council. After several days of searching, [event_envoy.GetHerHis] remains were found in a storage container destined to be incinerated.

The [From.GetAdj] authorities have been strangely evasive when asked to investigate, arousing suspicions that they were behind the killing - especially since [event_envoy.GetName] had been highly critical of the [From.GetGovernmentName] in recent times.

texts.zh: 一位[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡者来到了[Root.GetName]。由于信奉异端思想，这位“极端主义者”从城邦中被流放了出来，结果没有在任何到来的船只上登记显现。它直接出现在殖民地大型城市的中央广场，就好像空气突然物质化了一样，然后公开地宣告自己的信条能让它同虚境建立个人通讯。根据这个流亡者的说法，我们的人民可以通过共享梦境实现一种赐福状态。报告指出，殖民地里有很多人都听信了这个说法。
texts.en: An exile from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived on [Root.GetName]. Recently expelled from the Enclave for harbouring heretical views, this 'extremist' was not listed on the manifest of any incoming vessel. As if materializing out of the air, they appeared in the central square of the colony's largest city, publicly proclaiming a doctrine of personal communion with the Shroud. According to the exile, it is possible for our people to achieve a state of bliss akin to communal dreaming. Reports suggest that many in the colony are listening.

label.zh: 极端主义者在这里没有一席之地。把这个流亡者弄走。
label.en: Extremists have no place here. Remove the exile.

label.zh: 对拜访视而不见是不明智的。好好盯着这个流亡者。
label.en: Ignoring a visitation is unwise. Keep an eye on this exile.

label.zh: 以宾客的规格欢迎这位流亡者。
label.en: Welcome the exile as a guest.

texts.zh: 尽管我们做了最大的努力，在[Root.GetName]上行动的那个[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]流亡分子依然在躲避着我们。或许是拥有什么先天的灵能能力，它总是可以在我们的安保部队到达之前进行预判。除此之外，流亡者的布道还在吸引大量的群众。许多殖民者都放弃工作，以响应这个所谓的萨满所拥护的洗礼和冥想实践。
texts.en: Despite our best efforts, the exiled member of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] operating on [Root.GetName] continues to elude us. Perhaps due to some innate psionic ability, they have consistently been able to predict the arrival of our security forces. What's more, the exile's sermons continue to draw large crowds. Many colonists have begun to abandon their work in favor of the various ablutions and meditative practices espoused by this so-called shaman.

label.zh: 必须想办法阻止这个流亡者。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的安保部队成功地消灭了那个流亡的萨满。这个流放者前信徒中的一名——一位没能实现应许的梦境状态而逐渐心生不满的殖民者——向我们提供了必要的情报。普罗大众似乎接受了现实，然而，一小撮顽固分子似乎仍然抱守着萨满的教义。到目前为止，对这个殖民地增添安保人员似乎是有道理的，这样可以让人们对这位“殉道者”的尊敬逐渐消散褪去。
texts.en: Security forces on [Root.GetName] have successfully eliminated the rogue shaman. One of the exile's former adherents - a colonist who has grown increasingly disaffected by their failure to achieve the promised dream state - has provided us with the necessary intel. While the general populace appears to have accepted reality, an obstinate few remain dedicated to the shaman's teachings. For now, an increased security presence on the colony seems advisable, lest the veneration of this 'martyr' continue to fester.

texts.zh: 流亡萨满的教义继续在[Root.GetName]上的人群内传播。这种激进的教条是某种能够让个人同虚境沟通的宗派，其践行者宣称能够实现一种改变意识的状态。我们收到许多报告，称极乐与康宁的感觉有所提升。其中一些人甚至宣称，通过某种共享的、梦境一般的状态，他们能够使用灵能同其他人沟通。不幸的是，这些“真信者”引发了一波创纪录的离职潮。生产力受到了很大的打击。
texts.en: The teachings of the exiled shaman on [Root.GetName] continue to spread throughout the populace. This radical doctrine is one of personal communion with the Shroud, and its practitioners claim to have achieved an altered state of consciousness. We are receiving reports of increased feelings of euphoria and well-being. Some individuals even claim they are now able to psionically communicate with one another through a shared, dreamlike state. Unfortunately, these 'true believers' are also leaving their jobs in record numbers. Productivity has taken a hit.

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了惊人的新闻：那个流亡萨满宣称自己的业绩已经完成，明显已经离开了殖民地。报告很零散，且并不明确，但所有报告都同意一点，即在带领信徒进行了最后一次冥想之后，这位萨满就那样从殖民地的中心广场凭空消失了。对于那些信徒来说，这就是萨满“飞升”进入虚境的证据。
texts.en: Startling news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: proclaiming their work done, the exiled shaman has apparently left the colony. Reports are scattered and inconclusive, but they all agree that after leading their followers in a final meditation, the shaman simply vanished from the colony's central square. To their followers, this is evidence of the shaman's 'ascension' into the Shroud.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的事态有了奇怪的进展：在那个流亡萨满进行了所谓的“飞升”之后，我们的殖民者报告他们经历了一种意识的转换状态。这些人继续遵从萨满所推崇的仪式，现在已经能够进入一种灵能交流的状态。这种状态在殖民者间涌现出极大的欢愉和宁和，产生了深远的影响。
texts.en: Strange developments on [Root.GetName]: after the so-called 'ascension' of the exiled shaman, our colonists are reporting the experience of an altered state of consciousness. Continuing to follow the practices espoused by the shaman, these individuals are able to enter a state of psionic communion. The outpouring of joy and well-being this has produced amongst the colonists is profound.

texts.zh:
一艘载满了来自[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的流亡侍僧的运输船同我们进行了联络。他们称自己为“变革派”，要求在我们的某颗星球上进行难民庇护。

这一事件意味着虚境行者内部发生了前所未有的大分裂。看来，太空城邦也没有我们想象中的那么团结。
texts.en:
We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.

This represents an unprecedented schism within the Shroudwalkers. It would appear the Enclave is not as united as we were led to believe.

label.zh: 异种在我国境内没有容身之地。
label.en: Xenos have no place inside our borders.

texts.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们收到消息，听说我们的一些前侍僧已经作为难民在你的星球安顿下来。这一作为让我们极其不悦，但就这样吧。鲁莽的行动一般都会导致绝望的后果。但是要记住这点：这些改革派不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒，一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。庇护这群异端会让你冒风险。那些居住在虚境里的存在肯定会注意到这件事。”
texts.en: "The Shroud trembles. Word has reached us that some our former acolytes have taken refuge on one of your worlds. This has displeased us greatly, but so be it. Reckless action often leads to desperate results. Know this: these Reformers are nothing more than charlatans, vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Shroud. Shelter such heretics at your peril. Those that dwell within the Shroud have surely taken notice."

texts.zh: “虚境惊诧。我们已经收到消息，你拒绝了我们的前侍僧在你的国境内寻求庇护的请求。你做的很明智。这些‘改革派’不过是一群坑蒙拐骗之徒；一群无知的蠢蛋，以为自己掌握着破解虚境秘密的钥匙。任何决定庇护这群异端的团体都会冒风险。就让他们在太空中飘荡吧，无家可归，无心无肺，永远被此世和彼世遗忘。”
texts.en: "The Shroud shivers. Word has reached us that you have denied our former acolytes refuge within your borders. You are wise. These 'Reformers' are nothing more than charlatans; vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of the Shroud. Any who choose to shelter such heretics do so at their peril. Let them wander the void, homeless, hearthless, forever forsaken in this world and the next."

texts.zh:
“我们的恩主！在其他那么多世界置我们生死于不顾的时候，是你为我们提供了庇护……虚境一定会保佑你的，不论是此世还是彼世。我们的前同胞，[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]被传统遮蔽了双眼。虚境并非是不可渗透的。它存在一扇门，而我们发现了它的钥匙。

为了报答你的慷慨，我们愿意同你分享这个秘密。我们唯一要求的就是开工建设所需要的物资。”
texts.en:
"Our benefactors! That you have sheltered us, when so many others would have turned their backs... Surely the Shroud will bless you, both in this life and in that which lies Beyond. Our former brethren, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], are blinded by tradition. The Shroud is not impermeable. There is a Door, and we have discovered its Key.

In reward for your generosity, we would share these secrets with you. All we require are the resources with which to begin construction."

texts.zh:
“虚境惊诧！有了贵方的帮助，我们最终完成了大钥匙的建设。现在，我们最有天赋的同胞聚集在一起准备将其打开。随着他们的意识同钥匙连接在一起，他们的灵能能力得到了强化。此刻，这些勇敢的朝圣者进入了一个共享类梦境状态。当他们苏醒的时候，一扇前往虚境的大门就会打开。

愿那些居住的虚境中的存在为他们的努力赐福。”
texts.en:
"The Shroud shivers! With your help, we have at last completed construction of the Great Key. Even now, our most gifted brethren have gathered to begin the Opening. With their minds tethered to the Key, their psionic abilities have been amplified. Now, these brave pilgrims enter a shared dreamlike state. At their awakening, a Door to the Shroud will open.

May those that dwell within the Shroud bless their efforts."

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了令人难以置信的好消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道靓丽的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似强风的存在涌了出来，奶白色的亮光将天空渲染得五颜六色。刮过殖民地的灵能共振透过了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黄金时代”的黎明。
texts.en: Incredible news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A brilliant rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a great wind is issuing forth, iridescent with milky light. The psionic resonance that has blown through the colony has permeated the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many believe that this is the dawn a new 'golden age' on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来了灾难般的坏消息：改革派们从长达数月的出神状态中苏醒了过来，现在已经成功地打开了一扇通往虚境的大门。一道破败的时空裂缝出现在了殖民地的中心城市上方。现在，某种类似纱雾的存在涌了出来，邪恶的亮光将天空渲染得十分瘆人。刮过殖民地的灵能瘴气扭曲了改革派和殖民者的心以及意识。许多人相信这是[Root.GetName]“黑暗时代”的开端。
texts.en: Disastrous news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A ragged rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a sickly fog is issuing forth, lurid with vile light. The psionic miasma that has permeated the colony has twisted the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many view this as the beginning of a new 'dark age' on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 令人担忧的消息自我们位于[Root.GetName]的殖民地传来：尽管缺乏资源，某些狂热的改革分子依然试图自己锻造了钥匙。他们使用临时替代装置增强自己的灵能能力，进入了共享类梦境状态。这一举动造成了殖民地中心城市的上方出现了一个时空裂口。有毒的、诱发焦虑的烟气瞬间灌了出来，看上去是来自虚境本身。许多人将这一现象称之为“虚境恶臭”，并且我们被告知这样的体验并不愉悦。[Root.GetName]的民心普遍的降低了。
texts.en: Disturbing news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: despite the lack of resources, some of the more zealous Reformers attempted to fashion a Key themselves. By amplifying their psionic abilities with the makeshift device, they entered into a shared dreamlike state. This precipitated a breach in the fabric of spacetime above the colony's central city. Noxious, anxiety-inducing fumes are issuing forth, presumably from the Shroud itself. Many are calling this phenomenon 'Shroud Stench', and we are told the experience is far from pleasant. Morale on [Root.GetName] is at an all-time low.

texts.zh: 传感器发布了紧急预报，探测到了一个先前未曾标记的异常现象。考虑到这个事件中刚刚记录到的前所未有的灵能能量峰值，我们毫不怀疑这是一次和虚境的连结。这就是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]预知的改变吗？
texts.en: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?

texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的偏远地区发现了一个只能被认是位面传送门的东西。天气预报算法发现了奇怪的气流，最终被认为是大气从传送门轻微泄漏造成的。大气流失的速度十分缓慢，对[Root.GetName]上的生活不会造成什么影响。但这个传送门的存在引起了一些令人担忧的问题，比如它通向哪里，以及会不会有什么东西从传送门另一侧穿过来？
texts.en: What can only be described as a dimensional portal has been discovered in a remote location on [Root.GetName]. Weather prediction algorithms noticed a strange air current, which was eventually determined to be caused by the slight leakage of atmosphere into the portal. The rate of loss is far too small for it to make any difference to life on [Root.GetName], but the very existence of this portal raises some disturbing questions, such as where does it lead to, and could something come through the portal from the other side?

texts.zh: 调查位面传送门通向何方。
texts.en: Investigate where the Dimensional Portal leads to.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个邪恶的世界的。尝试跟该位面进行任何类型接触的生物体都会遭受到剧烈的痛楚，若是持续数分钟暴露在这种痛楚下，会产生强烈的暴力倾向。就连简单的采集该怪异位面的数据都会导致电脑系统出现不可修复的故障，或使得智能个体产生极大的不适。然而，我们发现骑士团的一件遗珍可以有效地保护佩戴者，并且可以让我们派出一名骑士进入。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any direct contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense violent urges. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings. However, we have found that one of the Order's relics wards its wearer effectively, and would allow us to send a single knight through.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通向了某个邪恶不安的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings due to the terrifying realization that one's very soul is being corrupted.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个从本质上对立于智慧意识的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm which is opposed to the sapient mind on a fundamental level. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes intense discomfort in the biological observer, and cascading errors in computer systems.

label.en: Find a way to close the Portal!

label.zh: 祈祷能够找到解决方法
试试用石头填满传送门！
label.en: Try filling the Portal with rocks!

tooltips.zh: 可以对位面传送门进行长期研究。
tooltips.en: The Dimensional Portal can be studied on an ongoing basis.

texts.zh: 通过科学研究一定可以找到关闭这个传送门的方法！
texts.en: There has to be a way to close this portal, and science will find it!

texts.zh: 我们发现传送门可以容纳几乎无限的能量，但关键字是“几乎”。通过以前所未有的规模生产能量，并对传送门进行持续轰炸，最终导致传送门过载并坍塌了。很显然，生产巨大能量的能力也可以用于其它领域。
texts.en: The Portal was determined to be able to handle almost unlimited energy input, but the key word is "almost". By generating energy at an unprecedented scale and continuously bombarding the Portal, it was eventually possible to cause it to overload and collapse in on itself. Needless to say, the generation of vast amounts of energy has the potential to be useful in other areas.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

texts.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用灵能来反制！
texts.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with Psionic energy!

texts.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能力非常敏感。因此我们召集了一些天赋异禀的个体，在传送门周围制造了一个灵能屏障，将它与世隔绝开。这一经历启发了我们，并且证明了用灵能创造实体屏障是可行的。
texts.en: The Portal proved to be sensitive to psionic force. With an assembled team of gifted individuals, we created a psionic barrier around the portal, preventing any access. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to form solid barriers from psionic energy.

texts.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能输入非常敏感。我们利用灵能单元在传送门周围创造了一个灵能屏障，避免未授权访问。该事件获取的数据会在未来研究中大有可用。
texts.en: The Portal has proven to be sensitive to psionic input. Through the use of our psionic units, a barrier has been constructed around the portal, preventing unauthorized access. The data from this event will prove useful in our future research.

texts.zh: 传送门似乎会对附近观察者的思维产生某种反应，有些人产生的反应比其他人更大。通过筛选，我们挑选了一大群对传送门影响较大的人，用共同的意念关闭了传送门。这一经历启发了我们，并确实证明了信念的力量能被实际运用。
texts.en: The Portal seemed to react in some way to the thoughts of nearby observers, some more than others. Through a process of elimination it was possible to find a large number of people who were especially potent at influencing the Portal, and together they were able to effectively will the Portal to close. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to harness and direct belief in tangible ways.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

texts.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用正能量来反制！
texts.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with positive energy!

texts.zh: 往里丢足够多的石头，或许可以把它堵住？
texts.en: Perhaps dumping enough rock into the portal will block it up?

texts.zh: 有时最简单的答案也是最好的答案。在将数座大山炸成碎石并倒进传送门之后，它似乎过载了，也有可能是被刻意关闭了。无论如何，我们仍将剩余的碎石倒在了传送门的位置上，以防止它再次开启。我们从这一经历中吸取了许多工程与采矿方面的经验，可以在其它领域派上用场。
texts.en: Sometimes a simple answer is the best answer. After blasting several mountains into gravel and dumping the result into the portal, it seems to have been overloaded. Or, perhaps, was deliberately shut down. Regardless, the remaining material was dumped on top of the site in case it ever re-opens. The experience of such a large engineering and mining project will also prove useful in other areas.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

texts.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今此人回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]形态扭曲，被黑暗笼罩，带领了一支恐怖之军穿过了传送门，立马开始袭击我们的殖民地。幸存者称他们听到[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]爆发出恶魔般的笑声，并宣称[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]将很快征服这个位面。
texts.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. Twisted and darkened, [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] led a host of horrors through the portal and immediately assaulted our colony. Survivors reported hearing [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] erupt in a demonic cackle, claiming [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] would soon conquer this dimension.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

tooltips.zh: 多支恶魔军队将袭击殖民地！
tooltips.en: Several Daemonic Armies will attack the colony!

texts.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今已经回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]历经万难，击败了无数的敌人，几乎是侥幸地保全了[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的性命，但最终，没有什么能阻挡[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]的去路。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]带回了许多战利品，并在扈从间成为了传说，大家开始称[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]为“末日杀手”。
texts.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] bested many a challenge, felled countless fiends and narrowly avoided [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] doom, but ultimately, nothing could stand in [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] way. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] brought back many trophies and has become a legend amongst the squires, who have begun calling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] "Doomslayer".

label.en: [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is truly brave, ferocious and gallant!

texts.zh: 我们数年前将[doomslayer_knight.GetName]送去[Root.GetName]上的传送门，现在这个传送门正在释放强烈的活跃信号，一些衣衫褴褛的平民似乎正试图穿越到我们的位面。他们汇报称，[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]骑士已经在他们的位面肆虐了十几年，无情地屠戮着任何出现在[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]面前的人。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]在那个未免杀害了那么多居民，甚至对他们的社会造成了毁灭性的影响。幸存者无助地向任何能抵达的地方逃亡。难道是这个位面的痛苦使[doomslayer_knight.GetName]陷入了疯狂？
texts.en: The portal on [Root.GetName] where we sent Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] years ago is showing intense signs of activity as ragged civilians appear to be attempting to cross into our dimension. They report that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] has been rampaging in their dimension for a decade now, mercilessly slaughtering everyone crossing [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] path. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] slew so many inhabitants of that dimension that a doom has befallen their society. The survivors are trying to flee anywhere they can. Could the existential pain caused by this dimension have driven [doomslayer_knight.GetName] to madness?

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

tooltips.zh: 4恶魔人口将出现在[Root.GetName]上。
tooltips.en: 4 Daemon pops will be created on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向由纯能量所形成的世界。我们成功通过传送门汲取少量的能量过来我们的世界。这些能量“包裹”拥有开发成武器的潜力。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure energy, a small amount of which can be siphoned through the portal for our own use. The procedures used to handle discrete "packets" of energy also have potential use as a weapons system.

tooltips.zh: 位面传送门研究者也将生产£energy£ 能量币
tooltips.en: Dimensional Portal Researchers will also produce £energy£ Energy

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门通往一个由纯粹的熵构成的次元。就连传感器都几乎无法取得读数，因为我们信号的能量很快就消散了。最具可信度的理论是，这一“太虚”的大多数零点能量都为负，任何曾经存在的正能量都早已耗尽。我们或许可以制造一种武器，将太虚的能量消散特性化为武器。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure entropy. It is difficult to even get sensor readings because the very energy of our pings is rapidly dissipated. Our best theory is that this "Null Void" is a dimension where the majority of zero-point energy is negative and so any positive energy which was once present has long since been used up. Knowing this, it might be possible to construct a weapon which can use the Null Void's energy destruction offensively.

tooltips.zh: 位面传送门研究者也将生产£sr_dark_matter£ 暗物质
tooltips.en: Dimensional Portal Researchers will also produce £sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter

texts.zh: 在多年的研究之后，[Root.GetName]上的某些研究者们觉得自己开始理解太虚了。有一些……波动。力量。一股流动轻柔地通过传送门流向[From.GetName]，并带来我们可以收集的微量暗物质。从理论上讲，我们应该可以使我们的传送门对这股波动更加“显眼”，以此产生更多的暗物质。
texts.en: After years of study, some researchers on [Root.GetName] are beginning to feel they understand the Null Void. There are... currents. Forces. Some flow which gently pushes against the portal to [From.GetName], bringing the traces of Dark Matter we are able to collect. In theory it should be possible to make our portal more "visible" to this force, which should result in a larger harvest.

texts.zh: 无论是什么样的力量在将暗物质带往我们的传送门，将其更多的吸引过来应该可以增加暗物质的产出。
texts.en: Whatever the strange force bringing Dark Matter to our portal is, attracting a higher level of it should result in increased production.

texts.zh: 一座巨大的信号增幅器将一道能量射入了[Root.GetName]上的传送门。效果立竿见影，传送门另一端的压力明显开始增加，并涌出了更多的暗物质流。
texts.en: A vast signal amplifier has sent a blast of energy through the portal on [Root.GetName]. The effect was immediate, the pressure on the far side of the portal is noticeably stronger, and with it comes an increased flow of Dark Matter.

tooltips.zh: 位面传送门研究者将生产额外的£sr_dark_matter£暗物质
tooltips.en: Dimensional Portal Researchers will produce additional £sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter

texts.zh: 奇怪的是，[Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通往一个与[Root.GetName]非常相似的星球。更奇怪的是，里面有一个信号正向我们传来……
texts.en: Strangely, the Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to connect to a planet which looks very much like [Root.GetName]. Stranger still, there's a signal being broadcast to us through it...

texts.zh: 我是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。传送门外星人，你们是谁？
texts.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Who are you, Portal-aliens?

texts.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。表明你的身份！
texts.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Identify!

label.zh: 校验错误：身份无效！这里是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]！表明你的身份！
label.en: Checksum error: invalid ID! This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]! Identify!

texts.zh: 这太神奇了。如果你说的是真的，我想这座传送门应该是连通平行世界的桥梁。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，但在某一时点上，我们各自次元中一定发生了某种差异，使我们的世界线产生了分歧。
texts.en: Fascinating. If what you say is true, I think this portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both the [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], but at some point an event must have caused our respective dimensions to diverge.

texts.zh: **处理中！** 结果：这道传送门连通着次元之间的缝隙。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，来自不同的次元。
texts.en: **PROCESSING!** Results: This portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], from divergent dimensions.

label.zh: 真神奇。告诉我们你们那的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]过得如何。
label.en: Amazing. Tell us how your [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] fare!

label.zh: 我们应该通过传送门进行贸易。
label.en: We should trade through our portal.

responses.zh: 我也正有此意，为了全体[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的利益！
responses.en: I was about to suggest that myself, for the benefit of all [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

label.zh: 一个未计算的变量。报告另一个[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的状况！
label.en: An uncalculated variable. Report status of alternate [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

texts.zh: 我想应该和你们那边差不多。我们从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]向太空中发展，利用新发明的曲速引擎——
texts.en: Much the same as it fares in your dimension, I expect. We have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

texts.zh: 在发明曲速引擎之后，[Root.Owner.Species.GetName]从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]开始向星海进发——
texts.en: The [Root.Owner.Species.GetName] have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

label.zh: 曲速引擎？我们用的是超空间航道！
label.en: The Warp Drive? We travel by Hyperlanes!

label.zh: 错误！意外值：曲速引擎。预期值：超空间航道。
label.en: Error! Unexpected value: Warp Drive. Expected value: Hyperlanes.

texts.zh: 超空间航道？或许发现不同类型的超光速旅行方法，正是我们平行世界之间的分歧点？这是否意味着你们并未受到曲速兽的侵扰？
texts.en: Hyperlanes? Perhaps discovering different types of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes? Does this mean you are not beset by the Warp beasts?

texts.zh: **处理中！** 结果：探索出不同类型的超光速旅行方式是我们宇宙之间的分歧点。查询：曲速兽袭击？
texts.en: **PROCESSING!** Results: Discovering a different type of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes. Query: Warp beast assault?

label.zh: 没听说过什么曲速兽。它们构成了很大的威胁吗？
label.en: No Warp beasts here. Are they a serious threat?

label.zh: 值未找到：曲速兽。查询：曲速兽威胁等级？
label.en: Value not found: Warp beasts. Query: Threat level of Warp beasts?

texts.zh: 曲速兽会攻击所有已知的文明。它们是所有生命之敌。据我们所知，一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界程度，曲速兽就会苏醒并攻击。已经有数个物种被它们消灭了，但目前我们还撑得住。
texts.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all life. As far as we have determined, once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

texts.zh: 曲速兽袭击所有已知文明，它们是所有存在的威胁。假设：一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界值，曲速兽将觉醒并攻击。数个物种已灭亡，但目前我们仍撑得住。
texts.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all existence. Hypothesis: Once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

label.zh: 听起来真可怕。我们能帮上忙吗？

responses.zh: 是的，我们应该签订跨次元贸易协定，来增强我们两国的实力。为了全体[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的利益！
responses.en: Yes, we should establish an inter-dimensional trade treaty to strengthen both our nations. For the benefit of all [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

label.zh: 查询：你是否需要物质支援？
label.en: Query: Do you require material support?

responses.zh: 设立跨次元贸易来增强两个次元的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
responses.en: Establish inter-dimensional trade to strengthen [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] in both dimensions.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的次元传送门自发关闭了。在我们稳定传送门后，看到它通向一个延绵不断的白色、无构造的虚空，仅有黑色噪点的随机条带穿插其中。这个奇怪的现象立刻开始渗入我们的宇宙并吞噬我们的稳定器，使得传送门发生了坍缩。

传送门、虚空和次元稳定器在同一个瞬间消失了，什么都没有留下，甚至连痕迹粒子都没有。若不是连传送门都没有稳定下来，谁知道这里将会发生何等灾难。
texts.en:
The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] shut itself. When we stabilized the portal, we saw that it led to a dimension consisting solely of a white, formless void interrupted only by random streaks of black noise. The strange phenomenon instantly started to seep into our universe and consumed our dimensional stabilizers, collapsing the gateway.

The portal, static, and dimensional stabilizers have all winked out of existence simultaneously. Nothing was left behind; not even trace particles. If the portal hadn't been unstable, who knows what kind of disaster might have occurred here.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

texts.zh: 最近，我们位于[Root.GetHomeWorldName]主要物理实验室的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在工作中发现了怪异的波动。与超空间有关的实验受到的干扰最为严重，但这些干扰仅仅持续了一周左右就彻底消失了。与此同时，[From.GetName]在那处已经关闭的传送门发现了一些波动，幸好那种不可能的虚空没有重现。希望这不会引起进一步的后果。
texts.en: Recently our [Root.GetScientistPlural] working in our primary physics lab on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have noticed strange fluctuations in their work. Our hyperdrive-related tests suffered most from these interferences, yet these interruptions only went on for about a week before stopping entirely. At the same time [From.GetName] noticed fluctuations from the now closed dimensional portal, thankfully the impossible static did not return. Hopefully, nothing will come of this.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一份尖端科学单元[cloned_physicist.GetName]发来的新报告。报告中阐述了关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质粒子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]在报告中称。

威胁分析子例程则建议在这一全新的不明物质被鉴定完毕之前先让舰队返回母星系。
texts.en:
A new report from lead physics unit [cloned_physicist.GetName] was received today. The report included recent findings of the spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes immensely as well as related subjects," reports science unit [cloned_physicist.GetName].

Threat analysis subroutines suggest bringing fleets home until the source of this new and untested material can be determined.

texts.zh:
我们收到了物理特化工蜂[cloned_physicist.GetName]的新观测结果，内容是关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”工蜂反馈称。

我们的意识不信任这一突然的发展和独特的感觉，敦促部分舰队返回母星系。
texts.en:
New observations from physics specialized drone [cloned_physicist.GetName] have been disseminated regarding the recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes and additional related subjects," reports the drone.

The Mind is untrusting of this sudden development and instinctively feels an urge to return some fleets to the spawning system.

texts.zh:
今天，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的科学界举行了一场充满了渴求与焦虑的学术报告，[cloned_physicist.GetName]发表了[cloned_physicist.GetHerHis]关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进我们对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]声称！

我们的海军部则对这些课题抱有不同的看法，并建议我们立刻让舰队返回母星系，直到这种全新的未知物质的来源被探明为止。
texts.en:
Eager and anxious discourse started in the scientific circles of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] today as [cloned_physicist.GetName] published [cloned_physicist.GetHerHis] recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance our understanding of artificial wormholes and a host of other subjects," proclaims [cloned_physicist.GetName]!

Our Admiralty holds a different view on the subject and suggests we bring our fleets home until the source of this new and untested matter can be determined.

texts.zh: 我们的母星周围最近出现了负相物质。这种奇怪的现象肯定不是动摇我们社会根基的事情的预兆。
texts.en: Negative Mass has recently appeared around our homeworld. The strange phenomenon surely won't be a herald of something that will shake our society's very core.

texts.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的科学单元，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
texts.en: Additional science units had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

texts.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的工蜂，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
texts.en: Additional drones had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]最伟大的头脑汇聚一堂，倾听[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于利用这些负向物质离子的最新想法，没想到报告被突然打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。地平线上，一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
texts.en: The greatest minds of the [Root.GetName] gathered today to listen to [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest ideas for using the negative mass particles, only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over horizons while a small fleet of fighters pours through the tear.

texts.zh: 传感器发布了紧急预报，探测到了一个先前未曾标记的异常现象。考虑到这个事件中刚刚记录到的前所未有的灵能能量峰值，我们毫不怀疑这是一次和虚境的连结。这就是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]预知的改变吗？
texts.en: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]传来了难以置信的新闻：今天早晨，某个宣称[hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself]是传奇英雄[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体来到了首都的大广场。目击者们说感到了一股出于敬畏的沉默，强大的冷静和宁和之感席卷了聚集起来的民众。尽管[hero_redivivus.GetName]在历史上人尽皆知，是一名伟大的雄辩家和充满激情的领袖，这名可疑的个体用单调的、几乎没有感情的腔调，诉说着自己在“死后世界”遇到的经历。此人宣称自己的返回并不是为了领导，而是为了抹除我们对死亡的恐惧。
texts.en: Incredible news from [Root.GetName]: early this morning, an individual proclaiming [hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself] to be the legendary hero [hero_redivivus.GetName] entered the great square of the capital. Witnesses describe scenes of awed silence, as powerful feelings of calm and wellbeing radiated throughout the gathering crowd. While [hero_redivivus.GetName] was known to history as a great orator and impassioned leader, the individual in question spoke of their supposed experience 'in the afterworld' in a simple, almost lighthearted tone. They claim to have returned not to lead, but to erase our fear of death.

texts.zh: 某个宣称自己是一名传奇英雄的个体来到了我们的母星。这样的暴论有可能是真的吗？
texts.en: An individual claiming to be a legendary hero has appeared on our homeworld. Could their wild assertions possibly be true?

texts.zh:
对那名宣称自己是[hero_redivivus.GetName]的个体进行的调查有了结论。一开始我们的研究者们保持了可以理解的怀疑态度，然而这名个体不仅展现出了对伟大英雄所在时代和当地文化的极其详尽的知识，DNA分析也确认此人和伟大英雄的数个已知后代存在基因上的联系。

不仅如此，对[hero_redivivus.GetName]脑电波图样的更深层研究表明，其大脑存在独特的灵能残留。看上去，与其说是“从死亡重返人间”，[hero_redivivus.GetName]更像是以某种方式被传送到了一个类似于虚境的位面。[hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap]对自己的“来世”经历显然很满意，[hero_redivivus.GetHisHer]现在安顿在首都郊区一处很安静的地方，并向愿意听从此人的群众布道，传播和平与无惧的信条。
texts.en:
The investigation into the individual claiming to be [hero_redivivus.GetName] has concluded. At first our researchers were understandably skeptical, but not only did the subject possess incredibly detailed knowledge of the great hero's time period and culture, DNA analysis confirms a genetic link to several known descendants.

Moreover, closer study of [hero_redivivus.GetName]'s' brainwave pattern revealed a distinct psionic residue. It seems likely that far from being 'returned from death', [hero_redivivus.GetName] was in some way transported to a realm akin the Shroud. [hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap] experience of this 'afterlife' was apparently a contented one, and [hero_redivivus.GetHisHer] has now settled into a quiet existence on the outskirts of the capital, preaching a doctrine of fearlessness and peace to any who will listen.

texts.zh: 传感器探测到了数艘运输舰船的接近。这些舰船磨损严重、破败不堪，看上去就像是用废旧零件拼接在一起的一样。船队旗舰的指挥官向我们发送了招呼，但基于他们当前科技的状况，恐怕只能进行语音通讯。
texts.en: Sensors detect the approach of several transport vessels. Battered and broken-down, the ships appear cobbled together from spare parts. The commander of the caravan's flagship is hailing us, but given the state of their technology, any communication is likely to be audio only.

texts.zh: 愿神赐福于你。我是这支船队的受命领袖。我们请求允许安全地通过你的宇域，并希望能够获得一些捐赠的食物。我们正在朝圣的路途中，在经年累月的太空生活之后，我的人民们变得十分孱弱。
texts.en: Divine blessings upon you. I am the anointed leader of this caravan. We ask for safe passage through your space, and a kind donation of food. We are on pilgrimage, and after long years in the void, my people grow thin.

label.zh: 我们必须尽可能地向他们提供帮助。
label.en: We will provide what aid we can.

label.zh: 你们可以通过，但我们匀不出食物。
label.en: You may pass, but we cannot spare the food.

texts.zh:
我的人民得以果腹，在此衷心感谢。事实上，我们到达此地绝非意外。数代人之前，一位强大的先知指明了一颗天国的星辰，说我们可以在那里触摸神明。这颗星辰属于你。

就是此地，我们自感官世界迈向祝圣之国度仅有一步之遥，但我们的船只很老旧，我们的科技还十分落后。要想同祝圣之国度进行接触，我们需要你的帮助。你不必相信我们的神明，但难道你会拒绝这个让我们接触神明的机会吗？求你了，给我们所需的资源，我们就能完成这场朝圣。
texts.en:
From my people, the gratitude of full bellies. In truth, our arrival here is no accident. Generations past, a powerful seer pointed to a star in the heavens and said that there we would reach the divine. Yours is that star.

Here, the border between the world of the senses and the Blessed Realm is thin, but our ships are old, and our technology second-rate. To make contact with the Blessed Realm we will need your help. You may not share our gods, but will you deny us the chance to meet them? Please, grant us the resources we need to complete our pilgrimage.

texts.zh:
那真是……美轮美奂。

代表所有朝圣者，我衷心地感谢你。我不是诗人。我无法将经历凝练成语言。但是多亏了你的慷慨施舍，我们触碰了神明。希望祝圣之国度的永恒荣光能够加诸你身。
texts.en:
It was... Brilliant.

On behalf of all pilgrims, I thank you. I am no poet. I cannot put the experience into words. But thanks to your generosity, we have touched the divine. May the eternal glory of the Blessed Realm be upon you.

texts.zh:
那支曾乞求我们提供援助的朝圣者船队结局十分惨烈。重构的遥测信号显示，他们进行了某种形式的实验，很有可能跟灵能有关。由于一次能量激增，他们旗舰引擎核心的遏止立场发生了破裂。接踵而至的爆炸摧毁了整个船队，并在[wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName]恒星系释放了一场威力强大的灵能风暴。所有预估都表明，此等规模的风暴需要数年才能消散。

不管这群神棍打算在这里做什么，很显然他们失败了，而我们还得在这里帮他们擦屁股。
texts.en:
The caravan of pilgrims who came to us begging for aid has met a grisly end. Reconstructive telemetry indicates they were engaged in some form of experiment, possibly psionic in nature. Due to a sudden spike in energy, the containment field around their flagship's engine core was breached. The resulting explosion destroyed the caravan, and has unleashed a potent Psionic Storm in the [wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName] system. Every estimate shows it will take several years before a storm of this size can dissipate.

Whatever these holy fools aimed to do here, they obviously failed, and we have been left to deal with the fallout.

texts.zh: 掌控虚境是一次长达10000次生死的旅途；哪怕是我们最天赋异禀的导师也只敢声称自己对虚境的神秘有一些片面的了解。即使如此，他们的智慧也是无价之宝。如果你有所求，我们可以排遣一名导师为你指点迷津。
texts.en: Mastery of the Shroud is a journey of 10,000 lifetimes; even our most gifted teachers can claim only partial knowledge of its mysteries. Nevertheless, their wisdom is invaluable. Should you wish it, we will dispatch one to guide your course.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

label.zh: 我们已经为虚境行者导师的效力付了钱。
label.en: We have already purchased the services of a Shroudwalker Teacher.

texts.zh: 学海无涯苦作舟：这便是最高级的智慧。我们会给你送去一名导师。好好学习，你必将有所收获。
texts.en: To know that there is always more to know: this is the highest wisdom. A teacher will be sent to you. Learn well, and you will surely reap the rewards.

texts.zh: 对于我们来说有句俗话：‘秘密在梦中翩翩起舞。’对于虚境来说，没有哪个堡垒是不可突破的，没有什么密码是破解不了的。通过我们的冥想，其他人坚信深藏不露的东西会乖乖呈现在我们面前。你有兴趣了解你身边的人在密谋些什么吗？去了解他们的设想，就好像那设想就是你的东西一样？如果你有所求，我们会分享自己的见解。怎么利用这些就是你自己的事了。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: 'Secrets dance in dreams.' To the Shroud, no vault is impenetrable, no code unbreakable. In our meditations, what others believe hidden is often laid bare. Would it interest you to learn what your peers are plotting? To know their designs as if they were your own? Should you wish it, we will share our insights. How you make use of them is up to you.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]会凝视虚境，以期获得对[Target.GetName]的内部运作具有指导意义的见解。
texts.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will peer into the Shroud in hopes of gaining insight into the inner workings of the [Target.GetName].

sections.zh: 我们对虚境的掌控加速了这个进程，允许我们协助[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的任务。
sections.en: Our mastery of the Shroud hastens the process and allows us to assist the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] with their task.

texts.zh: 虚境在波动；它的帷幕变得轻薄。我们将从冥想中退出来。我们窥得的所有见解都会对你公开。
texts.en: The Shroud wavers; its veil grows thin. We will now retire to our meditations. Whatever insights we glean will be made known to you.

texts.zh:
星系十分黑暗，危险无处不在。为了点亮朝圣者的路途，我们提供虚境信标。一旦在你的某个恒星基地上面安装这个，它的光芒可以穿透一切；哪怕是某些人称之为现实的缥缈薄暮。它延伸出来的网道可以穿过虚境，为凡间的舰船跨越巨大的时空前往遥远的距离提供了一种手段。

要谨慎地选择你的信标的位置——虚境隧道一旦生成，就不能被移除，也没有可能再召唤出另一个信标。

你要将以下的话语牢记在心：虚境隧道不是普通的道路，就算是我们也无法预测使用这种手段会有什么后果。
texts.en:
The galaxy is dark, and full of dangers. To illumine the path of wayward pilgrims we offer the Shroud Beacon. Once installed on one of your starbases, its light pierces all; even that thin veil some call reality. The Tunnel it spawns offers a bypass through the Shroud, and a means for corporeal vessels to traverse vast distances through space and time.

Choose the location of your Beacon carefully - once established, a Shroud Tunnel cannot be moved, and no secondary Beacon can call another forth.

You would do well to heed these words: a Shroud Tunnel is no ordinary road, and not even we can foretell all the consequences of such a journey.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们想要一个虚境信标。
label.en: We would like a Shroud Beacon.

tooltips.zh: 评价：£opinion£ +10
tooltips.en: Opinion: £opinion£ +10

tooltips.zh: 允许在己方某个恒星基地建造一个虚境信标。一旦完工，一个虚境隧道会在恒星系中生成，并提供一个通往[shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的双向隧道。我们只能生成一个虚境隧道；因此请谨慎选择恒星系的位置。
tooltips.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.

texts.zh: 一阵低语传达至我们的意识：虚境的道路缥缈不定，变换万千。愿这个信标点亮你前行的道路。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: the paths of the Shroud are strange and winding. May this Beacon light your way forward.

texts.zh: 我们对泽珞特别感兴趣。我们可以教你开采和储存的方法，但前提是你同意把你的产品永久地分成给我们。
texts.en: Zro is of particular interest to us. We could teach you the ways of harvesting and storing it, but only if you agree to give us a share of your production. In perpetuity.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
你们会拿到分成的。教教我们。
label.en: You'll get your share. Teach us.

tooltips.zh: 评价：£opinion£ +10
tooltips.en: Opinion: £opinion£ +10

texts.zh: 泽珞是一种奇妙而又可悲的物质，有很多用途，但绝不能轻易使用，因为它是一个上古物种最后的遗产。开采了就要好好珍惜，也别忘了回报我们。
texts.en: Zro is a wonderful yet tragic substance. It has many applications, but should never be used lightly, for it is the last legacy of a most venerable species. Harvest it, treasure it, and don't forget to pay us what you owe.

texts.zh:
确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。

然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
texts.en:
Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.

However, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be done responsibly, so our offer stands at that.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们没有恒星系可供裂分创造新裂隙。
label.en: There are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.

label.zh: 我们没有恒星系可供裂分创造新裂隙。
label.en: There are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.

texts.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向虚境的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
texts.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. The path you are inviting is a path to the Shroud.

We do not make this offer lightly. We trust that you will let us know when you are ready.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh:
一段非常有趣的故事。你说的是“面纱旅人”，对吧？在某些方面，这个虚境确实和我们自己的很像，但是对于不了解的人来说，这些差异可能很微妙；其实它们很深刻，是一种扭曲的反射，来自一个与我们不尽相同的宇宙。

虚境的表面有很多裂痕。那些深入其奥秘的人最终可能并不会回到他们本来的宇宙。
texts.en:
A most interesting story. Veilfarer, you said? In some ways, this coven does resemble our own, but while these differences may appear subtle to the uninitiated, they are profound: a distorted reflection, from an universe not quite like our own.

The Shroud has many tears on its surface. Those who enter its mysteries may not always end up in the same universe from whence they started.

label.zh: 跨越维度的灵能旅行……令人神往。

tooltips.zh: 灵能跃迁引擎科技出现是正常几率的1.5倍。
tooltips.en: Psi Jump Drive technology now appears at 1.5 times the normal rate.
